payload.description: list takes nothing; it returns every chat's heading, in the order the user set (5).

reply.description: Each chat's heading (12): id, title, the first line of its latest answer (subtitle), what it is linked to, when it changed, and whether it still has a finished turn the server has not confirmed. Or an honest error when the server cannot be reached; exactly one of `conversations` or `error` is present.

chapter.description: Which chapter of the linked book the thing was made in. For the Journal it is the day, as YYYY-MM-DD. For a book it is the chapter's title in lowercase letters a to z and digits 0 to 9, an accented letter written without its accent (ś as s, ł as l), each run of other characters made one hyphen and none at either end, so it survives the chapters being renumbered or the book re-imported. Absent when the link is to the whole book, as on every link made before chapters were recorded.

chapterTitle.description: The chapter's title as it read when the link was made, for display, so it still shows after the book changes or is gone; present exactly when chapter is.

subtitle.description: The first line of the latest answer that has text, as plain text, at most 120 characters; "" when there is none.

position.description: The chat's place in the list: a key that sorts by plain comparison, the list in ascending order (5).
